task: Replace the rejected Can I Be Honest teaser with a cinematic, song-specific 30-second vertical master.
audience: Listeners encountering an intimate slow song before the artist identity is locked.
first_read: Two people cross the emotional distance between separation and touch while the confession resolves.

references.label: Song evidence
references.reason: Hook window, pacing, emotional arc, and lyric selection

references.label: Creative treatment
references.reason: Motion thesis, timed six-shot structure, and explicit rejection of v1

direction.signature: A single amber seam becomes the distance between two people, then the point where they finally touch.
system: obsidian, umber, and warm cream palette
slow optical pushes with one restrained handheld beat
opening question and closing answer only

asset_quality.why_premium: Six custom song-specific cinematic plates share one lighting grammar and form a legible emotional sequence; Remotion supplies precise picture edit, typography, audio sync, and delivery finishing.

artifacts.notes: Encoded master sampled across all six shots and every cut boundary; 1080x1920 H.264, stereo AAC, 30.059 seconds, 24.4 MB. Full decode completed without errors.
Inspected for crop, hierarchy, palette continuity, image quality, and text safe area.
Twenty encoded frames around all five cuts inspected; no unintended black frames or cross-shot contamination.
Six generated plates inspected together for anatomy, lighting, palette, crop, and narrative coherence before animation.

checks.name: asset-tier
checks.evidence: Tier B custom generated cinematic plates are appropriate for a pre-identity music short.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.evidence: Encoded master, representative frames, and all cut boundaries were inspected after render.

checks.name: visual-qa
checks.evidence: Narrative progression, safe areas, typography, crop, palette continuity, and final touch payoff pass.

checks.name: technical-delivery
checks.evidence: 30.059s, 1080x1920, 30fps H.264, 48kHz stereo AAC; full ffmpeg decode completed without errors.

checks.name: motion-critic
checks.evidence: V1 was restarted at 15/30; V2 has one thesis, six motivated shots, rising intimacy, restrained type, clean cuts, and a decisive ending.

score.notes: 4 hierarchy + 2 brand/ownability + 4 craft + 4 accessibility/safe-area + 5 provenance + 2 release usefulness. The prior score graded polish while ignoring absent artist identity, native performance, market comparison, and platform testing.

iteration_history.reason: One procedural doorway and four title cards produced an animated poster, not a music video.
Clean visual development, but not a competitive release asset: no artist, performance, native temporal motion, participation premise, or tested hook system.

known_risks: Artist visual DNA remains unlocked, so imagery is song-specific rather than persona-specific.
Generated still plates use simulated camera motion; a future campaign master can exceed this with native video generation or directed live-action performance.
The Spotify Canvas candidate remains rejected until rebuilt from the new visual system.
No final video should be produced until lyrics, artist/persona, and an authenticated native-video route are locked.
